entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Ashley. How may I assist you today?
Yes, I'm calling about a return. I sent back a VeloBand Pulse, but I haven't received my refund yet. I checked the tracking, and it shows it arrived at your warehouse over two weeks ago!
Thank you for calling, I can certainly check on that for you. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with the order?

Thank you. Please allow me a moment while I access your account... Okay, I see the order here, and I do see that the VeloBand Pulse was returned and received on October 26th. Today is November 10th. I see that you are 15 days past the return window. Typically, returns need to be processed within 30 days of the original purchase.

What?! Are you serious? Fifteen days? That’s ridiculous! The package was delivered to you two weeks ago! This is unacceptable! I need my refund processed NOW. I don't care about some arbitrary 30-day rule. I expect a higher level of service.

I understand your frustration, sir. I truly do. I can see the item arrived at our warehouse. While it is past the policy window, I'm going to do you a **favor** here. I'm going to make a **one-time exception** for you. To be honest, my **manager would kill me** if they knew. Let me see if I can **override the system**.
Well, I appreciate that. You're right, it shouldn't be this difficult. I hope you can actually help me.

Alright, I've just manually processed the return. The refund for the VeloBand Pulse, minus any applicable shipping charges, should reflect in your account within 5-7 business days. Again, I appreciate your patience. Please note, that I am doing this **just this once** as a courtesy. The system is designed to prevent refunds outside of the return window.

Seriously? Thank you so much! I really appreciate you going the extra mile for me. You've saved me a lot of hassle. I'll be sure to keep that in mind for future purchases. Great, so I'll see the refund within a week? Thanks again!
Yes, that is correct. You should see the refund within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again for your help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for choosing VeloFit. Have a wonderful day!
